title: Crestview State launch before midterms
text:
Midterms at Crestview start around March 15, which is when students look for exam cram groups. Launch the first week of March so groups have time to meet at least once before exams.

*   Private beta with the ambassadors' friends the last week of February
*   Priya: make a Crestview version of the launch poster (school colors are navy and gold, keep our teal/coral logo)
